author: MattGaetz
text:
David Milstein -- one of Mike Huckabee's top aides in Israel and Mark Levin's step-son -- has very bad luck.

First, he accidentally found himself in a meeting with American-Israeli traitor Jonathan Pollard and Huckabee despite doing nothing to make it happen.

Then, he "accidentally" sent around explicit requests for cash payments ("in American dollars or Israeli shekels") to numerous Israelis, only to then claim -- once he found out POLITICO was reporting it -- that it was all a big accident and he only meant to send it to family and friends for his wedding, but somehow it ended up being sent to rich and powerful Israelis.

Hard to be such a "young man" plagued with such misfortune.
